ui.agents.detail.action.ask_change.note: Opens the configuration composer scoped to this agent. Sits beside Edit in the header's action row.

ui.agents.detail.action.discard_changes.note: Confirms discarding the edits on the pane. Same verb as the question beside it; no object because the question already named it.

ui.agents.detail.action.discard_question.note: Asked before edits are thrown away when the pane has no caller-supplied hint. Sentence case with a question mark, one line; wraps in the footer.
ui.agents.detail.action.discard_question.role: inline question in the sticky edit footer

ui.agents.detail.action.duplicate.note: Creates a copy the operator can edit. Named for the result, not the mechanism.

ui.agents.detail.action.edit.note: Switches the pane from reading to editing. One word where the language allows.

ui.agents.detail.action.keep_editing.note: Dismisses the discard question and returns focus to the field being edited. Mirrors discard_changes in length so the pair does not jump.

ui.agents.detail.action.more_actions.note: The overflow menu holding Duplicate. No visible label, so this is the button's only name.
ui.agents.detail.action.more_actions.role: accessible name for an icon-only menu button

ui.agents.detail.action.new_chat.note: Starts a chat with this agent as the scoped target.

ui.agents.detail.action.save_changes.note: Default for EditFooter's primary action when the caller passes no label; the agent and team panes both use it. Sentence case.

ui.agents.detail.action.saving.note: Replaces save_changes while the request runs; the button is disabled and aria-busy beside it. U+2026, not three dots.
ui.agents.detail.action.saving.role: primary button label while the write is in flight

ui.agents.detail.action.unsaved_changes.note: Says the pane holds edits that are not saved yet. Small meta weight; no colour of its own.
ui.agents.detail.action.unsaved_changes.role: quiet status marker at the end of the pane footer

ui.agents.detail.alert.builtin_body.note: A packaged agent has no editable registry row. Names both remedies: install a copy, or duplicate. Two sentences; wraps in the alert.
ui.agents.detail.alert.builtin_body.tone: plain, explains the limit and the way out

ui.agents.detail.alert.builtin_title.note: The record is one of the app's packaged agents, which is why Edit is absent.

ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_body.note: Another writer touched the record after this edit opened. Says the operator's edits survive and that saving writes only changed fields.
ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_body.tone: plain, precise about what is kept

ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_reload.note: Discards the local draft and shows the stored version. Sits under the sentence it remedies.
ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_reload.role: button label inside the conflict alert

ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_title.note: The record changed under an open editor. States the situation without implying the operator caused it.

ui.agents.detail.alert.save_failed_title.note: The save request failed. Shared by the detail and create panes, which both report through this alert slot.
ui.agents.detail.alert.save_failed_title.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.agents.detail.alert.unconfirmed_body.note: The backend did not answer, so the write's outcome is unknown; tells the reader to check the record before editing again.

ui.agents.detail.alert.unconfirmed_title.note: The write may or may not have landed. Does not claim failure.

ui.agents.detail.badge.modified.note: This copy diverges from the packaged original in some fields. Warning tone; sits beside the fact list.

ui.agents.detail.class.error_title.note: The messaging-class switch's write failed. The body under it carries the backend's own sentence.
ui.agents.detail.class.error_title.tone: plain, names what did not happen

ui.agents.detail.class.label.note: The control that lets this agent message the operator unprompted. Written as the agent speaking about itself.
ui.agents.detail.class.label.tone: plain, first person from the agent

ui.agents.detail.delegate.aria.note: Same words as the visible label beside it; the switch has no visible label of its own.
ui.agents.detail.delegate.aria.role: accessible name for the delegate switch

ui.agents.detail.delegate.label.note: The visible label beside the delegate switch. Says the agent may hand work to subagents.

ui.agents.detail.empty.used_by.note: No team names this agent as a manager or member. Sits where the team links would be.

ui.agents.detail.field.effort_placeholde.note: Placeholder in the effort-tier picker before a choice is made. Short: the control is narrow.

ui.agents.detail.field.name.note: Names the definition's name field in the editor. The value is the agent's or team's own name; this is only its label.

ui.agents.detail.kind.role.note: The wire value `role`, said in the operator's terms: they can start a chat with it. Pairs with kind.specialist.

ui.agents.detail.kind.specialist.note: The wire value `specialist`: other agents may reach for it rather than the operator opening a chat.

ui.agents.detail.no_description.note: Shared by the agents roster row, and any detail surface that has no description to show. Sits in the same line box as a real description so a row's height does not move; truncates in the roster, wraps in a detail pane.
ui.agents.detail.no_description.role: inline fallback where a description would be

ui.agents.detail.origin.changed.note: Lists the fields that differ from the packaged original, with the field names as data beside it.

ui.agents.detail.origin.source.note: The packaged seed a copy came from; the value beside it is a data token and stays as stored.

ui.agents.detail.read.effort_label.note: Introduces the effort tier in the read view. The colon and the space before the value are part of the message; the value itself is data.

ui.agents.detail.section.delegation.note: Covers delegation and effort tier together, because both answer 'how much work does it do'.

ui.agents.detail.section.instructions.note: The agent's instruction text. Also the field label for the same content in edit mode.

ui.agents.detail.section.messaging.note: Names the proactive/reactive switch block. The description under it explains both classes.

ui.agents.detail.section.name_role.note: Covers the create form's name and kind fields.

ui.agents.detail.section.origin.note: Where the definition came from: packaged, installed from a starter, or created here.

ui.agents.detail.section.tools.note: The tool surface block; also the label above the tools editor in the create form.

ui.agents.detail.section.used_by.note: Teams that reference this agent. Reads with the description under it.

ui.agents.detail.section.when_to_use.note: The one-sentence description a model reads when choosing an agent.

ui.agents.detail.tools.add.note: Appends the typed tool name to the list. Sits at the end of the tool input row.

ui.agents.detail.tools.all_label.note: Shown beside the 'every tool' switch and as a badge in the read view when the list is open-ended. One term for both.

ui.agents.detail.tools.empty.note: No tools listed yet. Names both ways forward: add one, or switch all tools on. One sentence; wraps.

ui.agents.detail.tools.every_tool_aria.note: The switch that clears the explicit list so the agent may use whatever the session offers.
ui.agents.detail.tools.every_tool_aria.role: accessible name for the all-tools switch

ui.agents.detail.tools.may_use_any.note: Explains the open-ended state under the switch. Contrasts with an explicit list.

ui.agents.detail.tools.placeholder.note: Placeholder in the tool-name input. One or two words: the field is narrow.
